Name: Simple Crayon Icons
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#F2C879]Simple Crayon Icons[/color][/b][/size][/center]

A little box of crayons for your inventory and valley.

The crayon style is based on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53823][b]Annabelle’s drawing skills[/b][/url] — colourful, playful little drawings for your inventory.

Bright colours, textured wax strokes and warm, uneven outlines give familiar items a playful illustrated look. The catalogue includes [b]1,583 supported inventory entries[/b]: 1,135 base item identities and 448 ingredient-specific variants.

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54347/54347-1792701486-1003528857.png[/img][/center]

[heading][color=#8FDAC0]✨ What's included[/color][/heading]
Crops and seeds, forage, fish, cooking, minerals, resources, equipment, hats, machines and supported decorations. Ingredient-specific artisan goods have their own artwork, and regular eggs remain smaller than large eggs.

Crayon artwork appears in [b]inventory grids[/b], with separate [b]toolbar and world options[/b]. Both options are on by default; existing saved choices are respected. Stack numbers, quality stars and tool meters retain native rendering.

The world option applies drawn crayon artwork to supported placed objects, dropped items and [b]182 big-craftable bodies[/b]. Terrain, crops, trees, buildings and interiors receive a [b]procedural wax texture[/b] over their loaded artwork, preserving native shapes, frames and shadows. These scenery assets are not individually redrawn. Held items, tool actions, worn equipment and tooltip item drawings keep their loaded artwork.

World artwork includes a [b]tall iron furnace[/b] and effects fitted to machine openings and moving parts, including the furnace, loom, kiln and Wood Chipper. Collection bubbles, output previews and badges remain native. This mod changes appearance; it does not add items or change their stats.

[heading][color=#C8B0F4]⚙️ Settings[/color][/heading]
In [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], use the separate Toolbar crayon icons and Crayon artwork in the world checkboxes, then Save. GMCM is optional. Without it, edit ToolbarEnabled, WorldEnabled and WorldStrength in this mod's config.json while the game is closed. World strength defaults to 70%; zero keeps native world artwork.

[heading][color=#C8B0F4]⚙️ Install[/color][/heading]
For [b]Stardew Valley 1.6 on PC[/b] with [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI 4.0 or later[/url].
Download the main file, extract the [b]SimpleCrayonIcons[/b] folder into your game's [b]Mods[/b] folder, then launch through SMAPI. Content Patcher is not required.
To uninstall, remove the SimpleCrayonIcons folder.

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54347/54347-1792701491-298253080.png[/img][/center]

[heading][color=#9ACAF7]🧩 Compatibility[/color][/heading]
[b]Choose Simple Crayon Icons OR Simple HD Icons.[/b] When Simple HD Icons is installed, Simple Crayon Icons deliberately stays inactive.

Unsupported items, custom item identities and items whose original sprite source has been changed by another mod fall back to their currently loaded artwork. This can produce a mix of crayon and other icons. The included catalogue does not cover every possible modded item.

The mod supports verified copies of object sheets, including aliases and extra rows, and known vanilla localized variants. Modified source cells still retain their loaded artwork. If an expected icon is missing, run [b]sci_diagnostics[/b] in the SMAPI console and include the coverage output with your log.

The inventory gallery images are from 1.1 and use a controlled native renderer; the furnace artwork was revised in 1.5. Native rendering and compatibility checks passed, but the reporter's own setup, Test an update on a copied save first.

[heading][color=#C8B0F4]🌍 Credits[/color][/heading]
Original Creator: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Xsyy]xSyy[/url]
Crayon artwork was created using AI image generation, then fitted and reviewed for the inventory catalogue. Stardew Valley and its original item designs belong to ConcernedApe.

[heading][color=#F2C879]💬 Bugs and suggestions[/color][/heading]
Please include the item name, a screenshot, your game and mod versions, and a [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log link[/url] when reporting a problem. Mention any other icon or item texture mods you use.

If you enjoy the crayon look, an endorsement is appreciated. Thank you!
